_about: P5-1.9 (Jake 2026-11-04): Ethereum-mainnet wallets exchanges publish THEMSELVES (proof-of-reserves lists, or the exchange's own published wallet list), read 2026-11-04 from the data_url of each entry. Third-party labels (DefiLlama, Arkham, Nansen, Etherscan) are not used. An exchange with no list, or one that could not be read from here, has eth_addresses [] and says why. Used only by settlement_extend.py cex-sweep.

binance.what_the_list_says_they_are: PoR wallet address list; fields network/address/thirdPartyCustodianName/createTime. No hot/cold label. 58 ETH rows (50 unique); 6 rows (5 unique addresses) have thirdPartyCustodianName='Ceffu' (third-party custodian): 0x3a3c006053a9b40286b9951a11be4c5808c11dc8, 0x4a9e49a45a4b2545cb177f79c7381a30e1dc261f, 0x71a7de1bdad3904b312717843597f549d2a79eb8, 0xb93b82f33e2653b544e046128f3cb47879dc917b, 0xd3a22590f8243f8e83ac230d1842c9af0404c4a1
binance.list_kind: hot/cold and custodian wallets (no label per address; 5 marked Ceffu custodian)

okx.what_the_list_says_they_are: No hot/cold/deposit label. Each row is signed with message 'I am an OKX address' (165 of the ETH addresses are instead signed 'I am an Okcoin address', i.e. OKX's Okcoin affiliate; kept in the list); Type column for these ETH addresses is 'Non Staking' (2 USDC rows 'Native Staking'). Network=='ETH' only (excluded ETH-ROBINHOOD, ARBITRUM, OPTIMISM, BASE, XLAYER, ETH_LINEA, ZKSYNC2 etc). Excluded 6,561 98-hex-char validator pubkeys listed under 'Native ETH Staking'/'Eigenlayer Staking'. Rows are per coin, so one address can appear for ETH, USDC, USDT-ERC20, LINK etc.
okx.list_kind: UNLABELLED - 17,383 signed addresses; may include per-user deposit addresses

bybit.what_the_list_says_they_are: Not retrieved: all bybit.com URLs 301-redirect to the homepage from this (US, x-country-code: US) egress. Bybit help centre says the address file is under 'View my audit data > Details > Download Proof of Funds' on the PoR page.
bybit.secondary_only: DefiLlama cex adapter; Hacken monthly PoR report 'verified wallets' table (third-party auditor)

bitget.what_the_list_says_they_are: No list obtainable: the page JS defines POST /v1/bill/proof/assets/public/queryReserveWalletDetailList but no current UI calls it and every parameter combination tried returns code 80003 'Parameter verification failed'; queryPlatformReserveDetail (auditId Au2026102112) returns walletAssetDetailListList: []. Page text: 'We use open-source tools to verify the wallet addresses holding Bitget's reserves' but shows only per-chain totals.

kucoin.what_the_list_says_they_are: Exchange publishes an address file but it needs login: GET /_api/asset-front/proof-of-reserves/wallet-asset/download returns {code:401,'Login expired.'}. Page: 'Users can verify ownership of on-chain wallet addresses and the total amount of wallet assets.'

gate.what_the_list_says_they_are: Not retrieved: Akamai 'Access Denied' 403 on gate.com and gate.io PoR pages.

htx.what_the_list_says_they_are: Not retrieved: page returns a JavaScript cookie challenge (EO_Bot_Ssid) instead of content.

cryptocom.what_the_list_says_they_are: No list on crypto.com: page says 'we've published our key wallet addresses' but the only link is 'View our reserves on Nansen.ai' (https://portfolio.nansen.ai/dashboard/crypto.com); PoR is a Mazars Merkle-tree audit as of 2022-12-07.

deribit.what_the_list_says_they_are: Not retrieved: PoR SPA page has no addresses in HTML; support article https://support.deribit.com/hc/en-us/articles/31211285163165-Proof-Of-Reserves is behind a Cloudflare challenge (403) and the Zendesk API returns RecordNotFound; press reports say the public PoR page is being retired after the Coinbase acquisition.

kraken.what_the_list_says_they_are: Merkle-tree PoR with third-party accountant attestation (page explains Merkle Leaf ID / path verification); no wallet address list on the page (0 hex addresses in page HTML).

coinbase.what_the_list_says_they_are: No PoR address list programme (relies on audited SEC financial statements); URL returned Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' 403.

upbit.what_the_list_says_they_are: No public PoR wallet address list found (SPA has no PoR page content; searches show only internal ledger-vs-on-chain reconciliation statements).
